description: This file is a header (.h) file for the Dem module in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software project. It declares constants, macros, function prototypes, and includes related to the Dem (Diagnostic Event Manager) component, which manages diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) and related data.

methods.name: Dem_PreInit
methods.description: Initializes the Dem module before full initialization.

methods.name: Dem_Init
methods.description: Performs full initialization of the Dem module.

methods.name: Dem_Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the Dem module.

methods.name: Dem_MainFunction
methods.description: Main cycle function for Dem module processing.

methods.name: Dem_SetEventStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of a specific diagnostic event.

methods.name: Dem_ResetEventStatus
methods.description: Resets the status of a specific diagnostic event.

methods.name: Dem_GetEventStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specific diagnostic event.

methods.name: Dem_GetEventFailed
methods.description: Checks if a diagnostic event has failed.

methods.name: Dem_GetEventTested
methods.description: Checks if a diagnostic event has been tested.

methods.name: Dem_GetFaultDetectionCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the fault detection counter for an event.

methods.name: Dem_SetOperationCycleState
methods.description: Sets the operation cycle state.

methods.name: Dem_GetDTCOfEvent
methods.description: Gets the DTC associated with an event.

methods.name: Dem_ReportErrorStatus
methods.description: Reports an error status for an event.

methods.name: Dem_ClearDTC
methods.description: Clears a Diagnostic Trouble Code.

methods.name: Dem_SetDTCFilter
methods.description: Sets a filter for DTCs.

methods.name: Dem_GetStatusOfDTC
methods.description: Gets the status of a specific DTC.

methods.name: Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailabilityMask
methods.description: Retrieves the mask indicating available DTC statuses.

methods.name: Dem_GetNumberOfFilteredDtc
methods.description: Gets the number of filtered DTCs.

methods.name: Dem_GetNextFilteredDTC
methods.description: Retrieves the next filtered DTC.

methods.name: Dem_GetExtendedDataRecordByDTC
methods.description: Retrieves extended data record for a DTC.

methods.name: Dem_GetSizeOfExtendedDataRecordByDTC
methods.description: Gets size of extended data record for a DTC.

methods.name: Dem_GetFreezeFrameDataByDTC
methods.description: Retrieves freeze frame data for a DTC.

methods.name: Dem_GetFreezeFrameDataIdentifierByDTC
methods.description: Retrieves freeze frame data identifiers for a DTC.

methods.name: Dem_GetSizeOfFreezeFrame
methods.description: Gets size of freeze frame data.

methods.name: Dem_SetDTCFilterForRecords
methods.description: Sets DTC filter for records.

methods.name: Dem_GetNextFilteredRecord
methods.description: Gets the next filtered record.

methods.name: Dem_GetDTCOfOBDFreezeFrame
methods.description: Gets DTC of OBD freeze frame.

methods.name: Dem_GetOBDFreezeFrameData
methods.description: Retrieves OBD freeze frame data.

methods.name: Dem_GetFreezeFramePids
methods.description: Retrieves freeze frame PIDs.
